t0033-01.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
t0033-01.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

t0033-02.gloss: A family member links a lingering illness to a field bottle smell, while a return note denies a spill.
